newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish 6.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Swedish 6.5 bln SKR T-bill auction oversubscribed.

text.p: Sweden's National Debt Office said on Wednesday that an auction of Treasury bills worth 6.5 billion crowns was heavily oversubscribed.
The average accepted rate in an auction of three-month Treasury bills worth 500 million crowns was 4.01 percent, the debt office said.
The office received 16 bids worth 2.23 billion crowns of which it accepted seven.
The office had invited bids for a total 1.0 billion crowns of six month paper and received bids worth 1.25 billion crowns.
It accepted 11 of 14 bids and the average accepted rate was 4.13 percent.
An auction of 11 month paper worth 5.0 billion crowns was heavily oversubscribed with the office receiving 55 bids worth 8.17 billion crowns.
It accepted 34 bids and the average accepted rate was 4.38 percent.
